name: Yuzu USD
oneLiner: yzUSD is Yuzu's KYC-gated base dollar on Plasma, minted 1:1 with USDT0; yield accrues through the separate syzUSD wrapper.
collateral: Overcollateralized by diversified on-chain DeFi yield strategies (leveraged loops, Pendle liquidity, Euler lending markets) deployed on Plasma chain; backed by >$1 in on-chain assets per yzUSD
pegMechanism: Eligible investors (accredited/institutional, KYC/AML required) mint/redeem at 1:1 with USDT0; peg maintained by overcollateralization and risk tranching via yzPP junior tranche absorbing first losses

mechanismArchetypeReview.rationale: Yuzu documents yzUSD as the senior claim on an overcollateralized on-chain strategy pool, minted against USDT0 and protected by the separate yzPP first-loss tranche. Within the closed taxonomy, cdp is the closest collateralized-debt archetype even though risk is pooled rather than held in borrower-specific vaults.

oracleRisk.summary: Yuzu documents yzUSD as a pooled, overcollateralized product minted and redeemed against USDT0, with yzPP as a first-loss tranche; it does not describe borrower-owned collateral positions with oracle-triggered liquidations.

branchApplicability.rationale: Yuzu describes yzUSD as a senior pool tranche minted against pooled backing assets and protected by the separate yzPP first-loss pool. Minting, redemption, and loss absorption are pool-level operations rather than borrower-specific debt positions with collateral-ratio liquidations, so no liquidation-oracle branch applies to yzUSD.

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: yzUSD's only material deployment is native issuance on Plasma. DefiLlama still reports ~24 yzUSD on a legacy Monad LayerZero OFT (0x9dcB0D17eDDE04D27F387c89fECb78654C373858), but peers(eid) returns zero for all probed endpoint ids on the Monad OFT (re-verified 2026-07-20 at block 88919965) and Yuzu announced it replaced LayerZero with Chainlink CCIP as its exclusive cross-chain infrastructure. The dormant Monad residue is inventoried as a reviewed subthreshold retired route and excluded from material tiering.

blacklistabilityReview.evidence: The verified Plasma implementation exposes pause controls for minting and redemption but no direct holder blacklist or freeze function. Yuzu's threat-response documentation can block malicious actors from protocol interaction, while issuer-freeze exposure remains inherited through reserve assets. The inherited status records that upstream exposure without asserting a direct yzUSD token restriction.

reserveReview.rationale: Write-time re-open of the Accountable dashboard API (cache.accountable.capital/dashboard/yuzu) and the issuer-domain mirror (yuzu-accountable.yuzu.money) on 2026-07-28 returned identical exposure_split rows dated exposure_split_ts=2026-07-21 14:49:15 UTC, with live total_reserves=$49,605,661.22, yzUSD supply=$45,386,369.29, and collateralization=1.092964 (dashboard ts ~2026-07-27T22:50Z). Percentages are published USD values / total_reserves, rounded to 2dp (sum 100.00). Material failure domains: Ethena USDe loop 37.44%, sUSDe loop 17.56%, Maple syrupUSDT/USDC/USDG loops 11.72%/9.61%/4.61%, yzPRIME 6.12%, Superstate USTB loop 5.05%, Agora PT-AUSD (spot+loop) 3.27%, USDT0 liquidity buffer 2.52%, Aave USDT0 1.07%. Prior Sky USDS and Aave USDC static rows are absent from the current attestor split and were removed rather than carried forward. Issuer docs corroborate Accountable as the live strategy breakdown, overcollateralized on-chain strategies (Ethena/Maple/Superstate/Aave-class, looping, tokenized T-bills), and the PoR surface; exact weights remain attestor-feed numbers (probable, not audit-verified).
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Accountable exposure_split snapshot of 2026-07-21 14:49:15 UTC normalized to total_reserves; dual host re-open 2026-07-28 (cache + yuzu-accountable.yuzu.money) with identical values; no estimates
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: 0.26% tail of disclosed sub-1% attestor rows (VBILL loop, Aave GHO/RLUSD/USDT dust, Rest_of_Assets) is not split into per-asset weights for dependency linking. 0.77% residual equals total_reserves minus sum(exposure_split); because exposure_split_ts is 2026-07-21 while total_reserves is the live dashboard figure, residual may include unpublished constituents and/or multi-day as-of drift.

nonLinkDispositions.rationale: yzPRIME is Yuzu's own prime fund token, not a tracked third-party stablecoin dependency.

Total backing exceeds the sum of the attestor's published exposure_split rows by this amount; no constituent detail is published for the residual, and the gap may partly reflect exposure_split vs live total_reserves timestamp skew.

custodyProfile.uncertainty: Write-time re-open 2026-07-28: Accountable still reports Fordefi workspace policy default_action=block and m_threshold=4 (fordefi.modified_at=2026-07-25), with fifteen disclosed main wallets and seven RWA fund wallets. Issuer Fordefi docs corroborate MPC custody over protocol funds. Legal segregation, insolvency treatment of strategy positions, and any off-chain custodial arrangements remain undisclosed; reserves are deliberately deployed into third-party yield strategies.

mintAuthority.summary: yzUSD mints via Yuzu's eligible-investor primary-mint model: 40 EOA accounts hold MINTER_ROLE on the Plasma token (enumerated exhaustively at block 27578074). Upgrades run through a 48-hour timelock (delay 172800s) with a 4-of-5 proposer Safe; limit/restriction parameters are managed by a 3-of-5 Safe behind a 12-hour timelock. Collateral operations sit in a Fordefi MPC treasury workspace.

review.evidence: At Plasma block 27099366, yzUSD is a TransparentUpgradeableProxy with implementation 0x32d7...5cfe and ProxyAdmin 0x6ccf...d2aa. ProxyAdmin.owner() is a 172800-second TimelockController proposed by a 4-of-5 Safe. LIMIT_MANAGER_ROLE and RESTRICTION_MANAGER_ROLE are each held by a 3-of-5 Safe and a 43200-second TimelockController proposed by that Safe; both Safes have the same five EOA owners. Full RoleGranted/RoleRevoked history reconciled against hasRole calls at block 27578074 found exactly 40 live MINTER_ROLE holders, all EOAs and enumerated in the direct-minter control evidence. Fordefi remains documented in custodyProfile but is excluded from mint controls because it has no mint authority.
